# External dependencies

## Reviewed usage

- **Current Python tooling**. Observed code imports are standard-library argparse, csv, hashlib, sys, and pathlib; the generator has no imported external package or hosted service client. The declared minimum local Python version is 3.11. ([`scripts/generate_codebook.py:6`](../../../scripts/generate_codebook.py#L6), [`docs/80_reference/804_tooling_and_corpus_requirements.md:24`](../804_tooling_and_corpus_requirements.md#L24))
- **Planned storage**. SQLite is a planned relational store, not an observed integration. The model proposes normalised CSV or JSONL first for a small pilot and defers PostgreSQL until concurrent access is justified. ([`docs/30_design/301_normalised_data_model.md:105`](../../30_design/301_normalised_data_model.md#L105), [`REPO_CONTRACT.md:85`](../../../REPO_CONTRACT.md#L85))
- **Candidate packages**. jsonschema, pytest, pandas or DuckDB, agreement-statistics packages, and ruff are candidate future dependencies. Their listing is a decision reference, not an installation or evaluation record. ([`docs/80_reference/804_tooling_and_corpus_requirements.md:29`](../804_tooling_and_corpus_requirements.md#L29), [`docs/80_reference/804_tooling_and_corpus_requirements.md:19`](../804_tooling_and_corpus_requirements.md#L19))
- **Candidate annotation platforms**. INCEpTION, CATMA, ELAN, Advene, VIA, and a locked spreadsheet are annotation-platform candidates. Selection depends on pilot works and unit types; no export/import integration is implemented. ([`docs/80_reference/804_tooling_and_corpus_requirements.md:41`](../804_tooling_and_corpus_requirements.md#L41), [`docs/80_reference/804_tooling_and_corpus_requirements.md:54`](../804_tooling_and_corpus_requirements.md#L54), [`docs/00_control/002_repo_status.md:60`](../../00_control/002_repo_status.md#L60))
- **Version control and publication boundary**. Git is documented for source and schema history. The repository status records public publication at YalcinkayaE/lit_pattern on 2026-11-11 and hosted README/licence checks; the delivery plan records the publication evidence. GitHub publication is separate from any future runtime integration.
